learning_outcomes.text: Provides knowledge and skills in developing team membership and leadership.
Possess theoretical knowledge about team building and development.
Includes applications aimed at the effectiveness of teamwork.

syllabus_topics: Interaction of cooperation and commitment in the understanding of teamwork
The role of organizational philosophy, structure system and policies in team effectiveness
Applications for creating an effective team within the enterprise
Goals, rules, and tasks in teamwork
Leader behavior and teamwork (Individual-team and leader relationship)
Teamwork and performance and performance ethics relationship
Advantages and disadvantages of team building in business applications
The role of teams in the organizational learning process
Examining the aspects of our culture that encourage and hinder teamwork
bibliography: Acar Baltaş, ‘Ekip Çalışması ve Liderlik’ İstanbul: Remzi Kitabevi, Aralık 2000
Stephen Robbins and T.Judge, Organizational Behavior, Printice Hall, 2009.
academic_year: vigente en el Bologna Bilgi Sistemi (Yeni)
